# Photo Studio

Photo Studio is a desktop application for photo editing with filters, layers, and export tools.

## Editor

The editor shows the photo canvas with a layers panel, filter toolbar, and export menu. The user can apply filters, adjust layers, and preview the result before exporting.

## Filters

Filters include black and white, sepia, vignette, and custom color curves.

## Export

Export to PNG, JPEG, or WebP at custom resolutions.

## Install

```bash
npm install -g photo-studio
```
